WLED Oval / Polar Ledmap Generator

Places LEDs on concentric ovals, snaps each one to the nearest cell of an oversized 2D matrix, and writes a sparse ledmap.json (empty cells are -1).

Fixture
Center line 0% ends in a single center LED (scaled rings); 100% gives the longest line, where the ring gap is the same on both axes. A longer line evens out the gaps between rings. "Even spacing" rings avoid the bunching that plain ellipses show between the axes.
Wiring
0° = top (12 o'clock); angles increase clockwise. Every ring starts at the start angle, viewed from the front.
Matrix
Smaller cells = more accurate placement, but more RAM and render time. Max 255×255.
Preview
ledmap.json
In WLED: set the LED count under LED Preferences to the total LED count, upload this as /ledmap.json via /edit, then reboot. The ring test image has the exact matrix size and paints each ring in its own color (see per-ring details); show it with Pixel Forge / the Image effect to check that the map matches the fixture.
Layout template (PDF)
Print at 100% / "Actual size" (no "fit to page"), then check the scale bar on each page. Page 1 is an overview showing where every sheet goes; the full-size sheets carry a 1 in / 20 mm grid centered on the fixture for alignment. Trim each sheet along its dashed line on the right and bottom edges and lay it over the overlap of the neighboring sheets.
